points.label: Correlation measures association
points.description: Correlation measures the degree and direction of the relationship between two variables; the coefficient lies between -1 and +1.

points.label: Regression estimates values
points.description: Regression establishes a functional relationship to estimate the value of a dependent variable from an independent variable.

points.label: Symmetry
points.description: The correlation coefficient is symmetric (rxy = ryx) with no dependent/independent distinction; regression coefficients are not symmetric (byx and bxy differ).

points.label: Effect of origin and scale
points.description: The correlation coefficient is independent of change of origin and scale; regression coefficients are independent of change of origin but not of scale.
